description: Layer 1 - Tiny fixes: pyjwt[crypto], PostHog PII safety comments, CI ISR_CACHE_KV placeholder guard
steps: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py, add a PII safety comment block above BOTH posthog.capture() calls (lines 239 and 449). The comment should warn: 'SECURITY/PII: Never send message content, user queries, or assistant responses to PostHog. Only send metadata (lang, model, latency, tier). Sending content violates our privacy policy and DPDP Act compliance.'

In .github/workflows/deploy-all.yml, in the deploy-edge job (around line 169), add a new step BEFORE the 'Deploy Worker' step. The step should: (a) be named 'Guard: check for KV placeholder IDs', (b) run a grep that checks apps/edge/wrangler.toml for the literal string 'placeholder' (case-insensitive), (c) fail with a clear error message if found, explaining the ISR_CACHE_KV IDs must be replaced before deploying.
acceptance_criteria: Both posthog.capture calls in chat.py have a PII safety comment above them
deploy-all.yml deploy-edge job has a placeholder guard step that runs before Deploy Worker
findings: All changes are config/comment-level. Python AST parse and YAML safe_load both pass. No test suite changes needed.
